title: Member Handbook: Direct-Shipped Bushels and the Share of the Year's Volume They Earn
content:
Grain the member shipped direct to a processor instead of delivering it into the cooperative's own facilities earns at a reduced share under Membership and Patronage Equity, because the cooperative handled none of it.

## Which statements are counted

The settlement statements counted here are the very statements the year's settled volume is taken from — the same 17 months up to today, less the same statements left to the new fiscal year by the reach — so that a statement left to the new year is left there for this purpose too. Those statements are the settlement statements of the member's Grain Marketing Contracts.

## The share

| Direct-ship bushels on the statements so counted | Share the year's settled volume counts at |
| --- | --- |
| more than a third of the volume settled inside the year | 0.5 of it, that is at half |
| standing on those statements, but not more than a third of that volume | 0.8 of it, that is at four fifths |
| none standing on them at all | the whole of it |

**Reading the first two lines.** The comparison is between the direct-ship bushels so counted and the volume settled inside the year. Where three times those direct-ship bushels exceeds the volume settled inside the year, they are more than a third of it and the share is 0.5; where three times them comes to the volume settled inside the year or less, and direct-ship bushels stand at all, the share is 0.8.

**Reading the third line.** Where the statements so counted carry no direct-ship disposition at all, the volume counts in full.

## Boundary cases on hypothetical figures

| Volume settled inside the year | Direct-ship bushels so counted | Where the boundary falls | Share |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 30000.00 | 12000.00 | three times 12000.00 is 36000.00, above 30000.00 | 0.5 |
| 30000.00 | 10000.00 | three times 10000.00 is exactly 30000.00, not above it | 0.8 |
| 30000.00 | 400.00 | three times 400.00 is 1200.00, well under 30000.00 | 0.8 |
| 30000.00 | none | no direct-ship bushels stand | the whole |

The exact third is the case to look at: bushels that are exactly a third of the volume settled inside the year are not more than a third, so the share is 0.8 and not 0.5.

**A statement left to the new year.** A direct-ship statement recorded inside the reach is left to the new fiscal year, and its bushels are outside the comparison altogether — neither in the direct-ship bushels nor in the volume settled inside the year.
